lead.what: Ethiopia required ten Eritrean diplomats in Addis Ababa to leave within 48 hours. Settlement is a named ministry, Al Jazeera or Xinhua statement that they have left, or remain, after 21:00 UTC on 3 October. The call is 0.68; Tinkerton dissents at 0.48.

rest.what: A US official told Al Jazeera the Theodore Roosevelt strike group left San Diego on Sunday. Leaving San Diego is not arriving in waters around Iran.

lead.what: El Al cancelled LY974-1 and LY972 on Friday after landing permission for Israeli airlines was revoked. The flights resume only once official permission is granted.
CNBC had the 10-year at 5.243 percent after a five-basis-point ease from a level last seen in April 2002.

rest.what: The interior ministry counted 1,949 arrests on Thursday. The Guardian attributed them to lycée students aged 15 to 18; the BBC called them people arrested.
